# TradeGlot Local Console



## Getting Started

### How to Get Started

Source: https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/JTI0aCUyRl9fZ2V0dGluZ19zdGFydGVk


# Introduction

API of the local TradeGlot console (127.0.0.1:8000). It uses synthetic data, expects the demo session headers the console sets, and the hosted demo answers 503 on every route that would reach PayPal. Authentication: create a session with POST /api/v1/demo/sessions, then send X-Demo-Session on every other call and X-CSRF-Token on every POST. POST calls also need an Origin header equal to the console's own origin (browsers add it; scripts must set it), otherwise the API answers 403 origin_required.


# Building

You must have Python `3.7+` installed on your system to install and run this SDK. This SDK package depends on other Python packages like pytest, etc. These dependencies are defined in the `requirements.txt` file that comes with the SDK. To resolve these dependencies, you can use the PIP Dependency manager. Install it by following steps at [https://pip.pypa.io/en/stable/installing/](https://pip.pypa.io/en/stable/installing/).

Python and PIP executables should be defined in your PATH. Open command prompt and type `pip --version`. This should display the version of the PIP Dependency Manager installed if your installation was successful and the paths are properly defined.

* Using command line, navigate to the directory containing the generated files (including `requirements.txt`) for the SDK.
* Run the command `pip install -r requirements.txt`. This should install all the required dependencies.

![Building SDK - Step 1](https://apidocs.io/illustration/python?workspaceFolder=Tradeglotlocalconsole-Python&step=installDependencies)


# Installation

The following section explains how to use the tradeglotlocalconsole library in a new project.

## 1. Open Project in an IDE

Open up a Python IDE like PyCharm. The basic workflow presented here is also applicable if you prefer using a different editor or IDE.

![Open project in PyCharm - Step 1](https://apidocs.io/illustration/python?workspaceFolder=Tradeglotlocalconsole-Python&step=pyCharm)

Click on `Open` in PyCharm to browse to your generated SDK directory and then click `OK`.

![Open project in PyCharm - Step 2](https://apidocs.io/illustration/python?workspaceFolder=Tradeglotlocalconsole-Python&step=openProject0)

The project files will be displayed in the side bar as follows:

![Open project in PyCharm - Step 3](https://apidocs.io/illustration/python?workspaceFolder=Tradeglotlocalconsole-Python&projectName=tradeglotlocalconsole&step=openProject1)

## 2. Add a new Test Project

Create a new directory by right clicking on the solution name as shown below:

![Add a new project in PyCharm - Step 1](https://apidocs.io/illustration/python?workspaceFolder=Tradeglotlocalconsole-Python&projectName=tradeglotlocalconsole&step=createDirectory)

Name the directory as "test".

![Add a new project in PyCharm - Step 2](https://apidocs.io/illustration/python?workspaceFolder=Tradeglotlocalconsole-Python&step=nameDirectory)

Add a python file to this project.

![Add a new project in PyCharm - Step 3](https://apidocs.io/illustration/python?workspaceFolder=Tradeglotlocalconsole-Python&projectName=tradeglotlocalconsole&step=createFile)

Name it "testSDK".

![Add a new project in PyCharm - Step 4](https://apidocs.io/illustration/python?workspaceFolder=Tradeglotlocalconsole-Python&projectName=tradeglotlocalconsole&step=nameFile)

In your python file you will be required to import the generated python library using the following code lines

```python
from tradeglotlocalconsole.tradeglotlocalconsole_client import TradeglotlocalconsoleClient
```

![Add a new project in PyCharm - Step 5](https://apidocs.io/illustration/python?workspaceFolder=Tradeglotlocalconsole-Python&projectName=tradeglotlocalconsole&libraryName=tradeglotlocalconsole.tradeglotlocalconsole_client&className=TradeglotlocalconsoleClient&step=projectFiles)

After this you can write code to instantiate an API client object, get a controller object and  make API calls. Sample code is given in the subsequent sections.

## 3. Run the Test Project

To run the file within your test project, right click on your Python file inside your Test project and click on `Run`

![Run Test Project - Step 1](https://apidocs.io/illustration/python?workspaceFolder=Tradeglotlocalconsole-Python&projectName=tradeglotlocalconsole&libraryName=tradeglotlocalconsole.tradeglotlocalconsole_client&className=TradeglotlocalconsoleClient&step=runProject)



# Initialize the API Client

The following parameters are configurable for the API Client:

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|  --- | --- | --- |
| http_client_instance | `Union[Session, HttpClientProvider]` | The Http Client passed from the sdk user for making requests |
| override_http_client_configuration | `bool` | The value which determines to override properties of the passed Http Client from the sdk user |
| http_call_back | `HttpCallBack` | The callback value that is invoked before and after an HTTP call is made to an endpoint |
| timeout | `float` | The value to use for connection timeout. <br> **Default: 60** |
| max_retries | `int` | The number of times to retry an endpoint call if it fails. <br> **Default: 0** |
| backoff_factor | `float` | A backoff factor to apply between attempts after the second try. <br> **Default: 2** |
| retry_statuses | `Array of int` | The http statuses on which retry is to be done. <br> **Default: [408, 413, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504, 521, 522, 524, 408, 413, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504, 521, 522, 524]** |
| retry_methods | `Array of string` | The http methods on which retry is to be done. <br> **Default: ["GET", "PUT", "GET", "PUT"]** |
| proxy_settings | [`ProxySettings`](https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/JTI0aCUyRl9fYWRkaXRpb25hbF9kb2N1bWVudGF0aW9uJTJGQ29uZmlndXJhdGlvbiUyRlByb3h5U2V0dGluZ3M) | Optional proxy configuration to route HTTP requests through a proxy server. |
| demo_csrf_credentials | [`DemoCsrfCredentials`](https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/JTI0aCUyRl9fYXV0aF9EZW1vQ3NyZg) | The credential object for Custom Header Signature |
| demo_session_credentials | [`DemoSessionCredentials`](https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/JTI0aCUyRl9fYXV0aF9EZW1vU2Vzc2lvbg) | The credential object for Custom Header Signature |

The API client can be initialized as follows:

## Code-Based Client Initialization

```python
from tradeglotlocalconsole.configuration import Environment
from tradeglotlocalconsole.http.auth.demo_csrf import DemoCsrfCredentials
from tradeglotlocalconsole.http.auth.demo_session import DemoSessionCredentials
from tradeglotlocalconsole.tradeglotlocalconsole_client import TradeglotlocalconsoleClient

client = TradeglotlocalconsoleClient(
    demo_csrf_credentials=DemoCsrfCredentials(
        x_csrf_token='X-CSRF-Token'
    ),
    demo_session_credentials=DemoSessionCredentials(
        x_demo_session='X-Demo-Session'
    ),
    environment=Environment.PRODUCTION
)
```

## Environment-Based Client Initialization

```python
from tradeglotlocalconsole.tradeglotlocalconsole_client import TradeglotlocalconsoleClient

# Specify the path to your .env file if it’s located outside the project’s root directory.
client = TradeglotlocalconsoleClient.from_environment(dotenv_path='/path/to/.env')
```

See the [Environment-Based Client Initialization](https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/JTI0aCUyRl9fYWRkaXRpb25hbF9kb2N1bWVudGF0aW9uJTJGQ29uZmlndXJhdGlvbiUyRkVudmlyb25tZW50LUJhc2VkJTI1MjBDbGllbnQlMjUyMEluaXRpYWxpemF0aW9u) section for details.


# Authorization

This API uses the following authentication schemes.

* [`DemoCsrf (Custom Header Signature)`](https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/JTI0aCUyRl9fYXV0aF9EZW1vQ3NyZg)
* [`DemoSession (Custom Header Signature)`](https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/JTI0aCUyRl9fYXV0aF9EZW1vU2Vzc2lvbg)

## DemoCsrf (Custom Header Signature)



Documentation for accessing and setting credentials for DemoCsrf.

### Auth Credentials

| Name | Type | Description | Getter |
|  --- | --- | --- | --- |
| X-CSRF-Token | `str` | CSRF token for the same session. Get it from the csrf_token field of the response to POST /api/v1/demo/sessions. Every POST also needs it; without it the API answers 403 csrf_rejected. | `x_csrf_token` |



**Note:** Auth credentials can be set using `DemoCsrfCredentials` object, passed in as named parameter `demo_csrf_credentials` in the client initialization.

### Usage Example

#### Client Initialization

You must provide credentials in the client as shown in the following code snippet.

```python
from tradeglotlocalconsole.http.auth.demo_csrf import DemoCsrfCredentials
from tradeglotlocalconsole.tradeglotlocalconsole_client import TradeglotlocalconsoleClient

client = TradeglotlocalconsoleClient(
    demo_csrf_credentials=DemoCsrfCredentials(
        x_csrf_token='X-CSRF-Token'
    )
)
```

## DemoSession (Custom Header Signature)



Documentation for accessing and setting credentials for DemoSession.

### Auth Credentials

| Name | Type | Description | Getter |
|  --- | --- | --- | --- |
| X-Demo-Session | `str` | Demo session id. Get it from the session_id field of the response to POST /api/v1/demo/sessions (that request needs no header). Without it the API answers 401 session_required. | `x_demo_session` |



**Note:** Auth credentials can be set using `DemoSessionCredentials` object, passed in as named parameter `demo_session_credentials` in the client initialization.

### Usage Example

#### Client Initialization

You must provide credentials in the client as shown in the following code snippet.

```python
from tradeglotlocalconsole.http.auth.demo_session import DemoSessionCredentials
from tradeglotlocalconsole.tradeglotlocalconsole_client import TradeglotlocalconsoleClient

client = TradeglotlocalconsoleClient(
    demo_session_credentials=DemoSessionCredentials(
        x_demo_session='X-Demo-Session'
    )
)
```


# Test the SDK

You can test the generated SDK and the server with test cases. `unittest` is used as the testing framework and `pytest` is used as the test runner. You can run the tests as follows:

Navigate to the root directory of the SDK and run the following commands


pip install -r test-requirements.txt
pytest




## Custom Content

### guides

#### mcp-server

Source: https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/cGFnZSUzQWd1aWRlcyUyRm1jcC1zZXJ2ZXI

The repository ships a small read-only MCP server, `src/payguard/mcp_server.py`, built on the Python standard library. It speaks newline-delimited JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio.


# Five tools, all read-only

| Tool | Returns |
| --- | --- |
| `check_acceptable_use` | A review signal for a product description. |
| `list_countries` | The ten countries in the rules pack. |
| `check_country_rules` | Findings for a seller and buyer country, most severe first, each with its source. |
| `search_rule_clauses` | The best matches among 140 paraphrased PayPal clauses. |
| `check_sales_spike` | A comparison with a baseline you declare; the answer says the baseline is unverified. |

There is no tool that sends evidence, connects to PayPal, approves or changes anything.


# Run it

```bash
PYTHONPATH=src python3 -B -m payguard.mcp_server
```



#### what-this-is

Source: https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/cGFnZSUzQWd1aWRlcyUyRndoYXQtdGhpcy1pcw

TradeGlot gives small PayPal sellers rule checks and a gated evidence workflow. Everything in this API documentation describes the **local console** (127.0.0.1:8000) and runs on **synthetic data** against the **PayPal Sandbox**.


# Safe by design

- Advisory only: every answer is a review signal. It is not a compliance decision and not legal advice.
- A person approves every send: one tick, then two presses. The hosted demo makes no PayPal calls and answers `503 hosted_demo_disabled` on every route that would.
- The AI step (Gemini) only picks from closed options and its picks are checked by rules. It does not guess and does not decide who wins.
- PayPal and the card issuer make every real decision.


# Where to go next

- Browse the endpoint groups on the left. Each one says whether the hosted demo answers it.
- Agents can use the same rule checks through the read-only MCP server: see the next guide.



## API Endpoints

### ai

#### Overview

Source: https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/JTI0aCUyRmFpJTJGX292ZXJ2aWV3

Evidence brief (local console with a model profile only).


# Get instance

An instance of the `AiController` class can be accessed from the API Client.

```
ai_controller = client.ai
```



#### Post Ai Evidence Brief

Source: https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/JTI0ZSUyRmFpJTJGcG9zdF9haV9ldmlkZW5jZV9icmllZg

Evidence Brief. Local console route POST /api/v1/ai/evidence-brief on synthetic data; advisory only. The hosted demo answers 503 hosted_demo_disabled here: it makes no provider calls.

```python
def post_ai_evidence_brief(self,
                          body)
```


# Authentication

This endpoint requires [DemoCsrf](https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/JTI0aCUyRl9fYXV0aF9EZW1vQ3NyZg) **AND** [DemoSession](https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/JTI0aCUyRl9fYXV0aF9EZW1vU2Vzc2lvbg)


# Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Tags | Description |
|  --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `body` | [`AiBriefHttpRequest`](https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/JTI0bSUyRkFpQnJpZWZIdHRwUmVxdWVzdA) | Body, Required | JSON body for: Evidence Brief. |


# Response Type

**200**: Successful Response

[`AiBriefResponse`](https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/JTI0bSUyRkFpQnJpZWZSZXNwb25zZQ)


# Example Usage

```python
body = AiBriefHttpRequest(
    stage=StageEnum.SOURCE_COMPLIANCE
)

result = ai_controller.post_ai_evidence_brief(body)
print(result)
```


# Errors

| HTTP Status Code | Error Description | Exception Class |
|  --- | --- | --- |
| 401 | A valid demo session is required (session_required). | [`ErrorBodyException`](https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/JTI0bSUyRkVycm9yQm9keQ) |
| 403 | Origin missing or not allowed, or the CSRF token is wrong (origin_required, origin_rejected, csrf_rejected). | [`ErrorBodyException`](https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/JTI0bSUyRkVycm9yQm9keQ) |
| 422 | The request does not match the accepted contract (schema_invalid). | [`ErrorBodyException`](https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/JTI0bSUyRkVycm9yQm9keQ) |
| 429 | Too many requests; the body says when to retry. | [`ErrorBodyException`](https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/JTI0bSUyRkVycm9yQm9keQ) |
| 503 | Hosted demo only: this route makes no provider call (hosted_demo_disabled). | [`ErrorBodyException`](https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/JTI0bSUyRkVycm9yQm9keQ) |



#### Get Ai Usage

Source: https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/JTI0ZSUyRmFpJTJGZ2V0X2FpX3VzYWdl

(optimise r24) This session's AI calls: stage, model, tokens, latency, estimated cost. No prompt or reply
text is ever stored; the hosted demo makes no model call and answers an empty list.

```python
def get_ai_usage(self)
```


# Authentication

This endpoint requires [DemoSession](https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/JTI0aCUyRl9fYXV0aF9EZW1vU2Vzc2lvbg)


# Response Type

**200**: Successful Response

[`AiUsageResponse`](https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/JTI0bSUyRkFpVXNhZ2VSZXNwb25zZQ)


# Example Usage

```python
result = ai_controller.get_ai_usage()
print(result)
```


# Example Response *(as JSON)*

```json
{
  "cost_note": "example",
  "entries": [
    {
      "at": "example",
      "latency_ms": 0,
      "outcome": "ok",
      "stage": "source_compliance"
    }
  ],
  "price_table_source": "example",
  "source": "session_memory"
}
```


# Errors

| HTTP Status Code | Error Description | Exception Class |
|  --- | --- | --- |
| 401 | A valid demo session is required (session_required). | [`ErrorBodyException`](https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/JTI0bSUyRkVycm9yQm9keQ) |
| 429 | Too many requests; the body says when to retry. | [`ErrorBodyException`](https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/JTI0bSUyRkVycm9yQm9keQ) |

Acceptable-use keyword check and the invoice review that follows it.

#### Post Aup Acknowledge

Source: https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/JTI0ZSUyRmF1cCUyRnBvc3RfYXVwX2Fja25vd2xlZGdl

Acknowledge Aup. Local console route POST /api/v1/aup/acknowledge on synthetic data; advisory only.

```python
def post_aup_acknowledge(self,
                        body)
```


# Authentication

This endpoint requires [DemoCsrf](https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/JTI0aCUyRl9fYXV0aF9EZW1vQ3NyZg) **AND** [DemoSession](https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/JTI0aCUyRl9fYXV0aF9EZW1vU2Vzc2lvbg)

| Parameter | Type | Tags | Description |
|  --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `body` | [`AupAcknowledgeRequest`](https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/JTI0bSUyRkF1cEFja25vd2xlZGdlUmVxdWVzdA) | Body, Required | JSON body for: Acknowledge Aup. |


# Response Type

**200**: Successful Response

[`AupAcknowledgeResponse`](https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/JTI0bSUyRkF1cEFja25vd2xlZGdlUmVzcG9uc2U)

```python

    choice=ChoiceEnum.CANCEL,
    description_digest='description_digest4',
    evaluation_id='evaluation_id0'

```

#### Post Aup Product Reference

Source: https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/JTI0ZSUyRmF1cCUyRnBvc3RfYXVwX3Byb2R1Y3RfcmVmZXJlbmNl

Aup Product Reference. Local console route POST /api/v1/aup/product-reference on synthetic data; advisory only.

```python
def post_aup_product_reference(self,
                              body)
```


# Authentication

This endpoint requires [DemoCsrf](https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/JTI0aCUyRl9fYXV0aF9EZW1vQ3NyZg) **AND** [DemoSession](https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/JTI0aCUyRl9fYXV0aF9EZW1vU2Vzc2lvbg)

| HTTP Status Code | Error Description | Exception Class |
|  --- | --- | --- |
| 401 | A valid demo session is required (session_required). | [`ErrorBodyException`](https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/JTI0bSUyRkVycm9yQm9keQ) |

| 422 | The request does not match the accepted contract (schema_invalid). | [`ErrorBodyException`](https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/JTI0bSUyRkVycm9yQm9keQ) |

This endpoint requires [DemoCsrf](https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/JTI0aCUyRl9fYXV0aF9EZW1vQ3NyZg) **AND** [DemoSession](https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/JTI0aCUyRl9fYXV0aF9EZW1vU2Vzc2lvbg)


# Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Tags | Description |
|  --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `body` | `Any` | Body, Required | JSON body for: Studio Agent Turn. |


# Response Type

**200**: Successful Response

`Any`


# Example Usage

```python
body = jsonpickle.decode('{}')

result = studio_controller.post_studio_agent_turn(body)
print(result)
```


# Errors

| HTTP Status Code | Error Description | Exception Class |
|  --- | --- | --- |
| 401 | A valid demo session is required (session_required). | [`ErrorBodyException`](https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/JTI0bSUyRkVycm9yQm9keQ) |
| 403 | Origin missing or not allowed, or the CSRF token is wrong (origin_required, origin_rejected, csrf_rejected). | [`ErrorBodyException`](https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/JTI0bSUyRkVycm9yQm9keQ) |
| 422 | The request does not match the accepted contract (schema_invalid). | [`ErrorBodyException`](https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/JTI0bSUyRkVycm9yQm9keQ) |
| 429 | Too many requests; the body says when to retry. | [`ErrorBodyException`](https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/JTI0bSUyRkVycm9yQm9keQ) |
| 503 | Hosted demo only: this route makes no provider call (hosted_demo_disabled). | [`ErrorBodyException`](https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/JTI0bSUyRkVycm9yQm9keQ) |

# Class Name

`Activity`


# Fields

| Name | Type | Tags | Description |
|  --- | --- | --- | --- |

#### Sent File Fingerprint

Source: https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/JTI0bSUyRlNlbnRGaWxlRmluZ2VycHJpbnQ

Plain SHA-256 of one file's exact bytes, recorded at the moment of a send so a later read-back can be compared.

The keyed `payload_sha256` cannot be checked outside the session; this one can. Never present on a preview.

)

#### Error Body

Source: https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/JTI0bSUyRkVycm9yQm9keQ

The error body every refusal uses.


# Class Name

`ErrorBodyException`


# Fields

| Name | Type | Tags | Description |
|  --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `error` | [`Error`](https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/JTI0bSUyRkVycm9y) | Required | What was refused and why. |


# Example

```python
try:
    # make the API call
except ErrorBodyException as e:
    print(e)
except APIException as e:
    print(e)
```

## SDK Infrastructure

### Configuration

#### ProxySettings

Source: https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/JTI0aCUyRl9fYWRkaXRpb25hbF9kb2N1bWVudGF0aW9uJTJGQ29uZmlndXJhdGlvbiUyRlByb3h5U2V0dGluZ3M


Represents the proxy server configurations for API calls.

# Properties

| Name | Type | Tag | Description |
|  --- | --- | --- | --- |
| address | `str` | required | The proxy server URL. |
| port | `int` | optional | The port to connect to the proxy server. |
| username | `str` | optional | Username for proxy authentication. |
| password | `str` | optional | Password for proxy authentication. |

# Usage Example

```python
from tradeglotlocalconsole.tradeglotlocalconsole_client import TradeglotlocalconsoleClient
from tradeglotlocalconsole.http.proxy_settings import ProxySettings

client = TradeglotlocalconsoleClient(
    proxy_settings=ProxySettings(
        address='http://localhost',
        port=8888,
        username='user',
        password='pass'
     )
)
```



#### Environment-Based Client Initialization

Source: https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/JTI0aCUyRl9fYWRkaXRpb25hbF9kb2N1bWVudGF0aW9uJTJGQ29uZmlndXJhdGlvbiUyRkVudmlyb25tZW50LUJhc2VkJTI1MjBDbGllbnQlMjUyMEluaXRpYWxpemF0aW9u

The SDK client can also be initialized directly from environment variables using the `from_environment()` class method. This allows the SDK to automatically read configuration values from the runtime environment or a .env file.

# Example

```python
from tradeglotlocalconsole.tradeglotlocalconsole_client import TradeglotlocalconsoleClient

# Specify the path to your .env file if it’s located outside the project’s root directory.
client = TradeglotlocalconsoleClient.from_environment(dotenv_path='/path/to/.env')
```

You can also specify a path to a `.env` file by passing it to the `from_environment()` method:

The same method can accept keyword arguments to override any values read from the environment, and the arguments to override values should follow the same approach as code-based client initialization.

```python
from tradeglotlocalconsole.tradeglotlocalconsole_client import TradeglotlocalconsoleClient

client = TradeglotlocalconsoleClient.from_environment(
    dotenv_path='/path/to/.env',
    timeout=0,  # overrides timeout from environment variable
)
```

Values provided through arguments take precedence over those defined in environment variables.

# Example `.env` File

```python
ENVIRONMENT=production

DEMO_CSRF_X_CSRF_TOKEN=ExampleXCSRFToken
DEMO_SESSION_X_DEMO_SESSION=ExampleXDemoSession

TIMEOUT=60
MAX_RETRIES=3
BACKOFF_FACTOR=2
RETRY_STATUSES=408,413
RETRY_METHODS=GET,PUT,DELETE

# Proxy Configuration
PROXY_ADDRESS=https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal
PROXY_PORT=8080
PROXY_USERNAME=username
PROXY_PASSWORD=password
```

# Note

- If an environment variable is not defined, the default SDK configuration value will be used.



### HTTP

#### HttpResponse

Source: https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/JTI0aCUyRl9fYWRkaXRpb25hbF9kb2N1bWVudGF0aW9uJTJGSFRUUCUyRkh0dHBSZXNwb25zZQ

Http response received.

# Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
|  --- | --- | --- |
| status_code | `int` | The status code returned by the server. |
| reason_phrase | `str` | The reason phrase returned by the server. |
| headers | `dict` | Response headers. |
| text | `str` | Response body. |
| request | [`HttpRequest`](https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/JTI0aCUyRl9fYWRkaXRpb25hbF9kb2N1bWVudGF0aW9uJTJGSFRUUCUyRkh0dHBSZXF1ZXN0) | The request that resulted in this response. |



#### HttpRequest

Source: https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/JTI0aCUyRl9fYWRkaXRpb25hbF9kb2N1bWVudGF0aW9uJTJGSFRUUCUyRkh0dHBSZXF1ZXN0

Represents a single Http Request.

# Parameters

| Name | Type | Tag | Description |
|  --- | --- | --- | --- |
| http_method | `HttpMethodEnum` |  | The HTTP method of the request. |
| query_url | `str` |  | The endpoint URL for the API request. |
| headers | `dict` | optional | Request headers. |
| query_parameters | `dict` | optional | Query parameters to add in the URL. |
| parameters | `dict` | optional | Request body, either as a serialized string or else a list of parameters to form encode. |
| files | `dict` | optional | Files to be sent with the request. |



### Utilities

#### ApiHelper

Source: https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/JTI0aCUyRl9fYWRkaXRpb25hbF9kb2N1bWVudGF0aW9uJTJGVXRpbGl0aWVzJTJGQXBpSGVscGVy

#### HttpDateTime

Source: https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/JTI0aCUyRl9fYWRkaXRpb25hbF9kb2N1bWVudGF0aW9uJTJGVXRpbGl0aWVzJTJGSHR0cERhdGVUaW1l

A utility class for wrapping datetime to support HTTP date format.

# Methods

| Name | Description |
|  --- | --- |
| from_datetime | Converts a datetime object to an HTTP-compliant date string. |
| from_value | Parses an HTTP date string into a datetime object. |



#### RFC3339DateTime

Source: https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/JTI0aCUyRl9fYWRkaXRpb25hbF9kb2N1bWVudGF0aW9uJTJGVXRpbGl0aWVzJTJGUkZDMzMzOURhdGVUaW1l

#### UnixDateTime

Source: https://jiarong0423.github.io/payguard-ai/portal/#/python/x-redirect/JTI0aCUyRl9fYWRkaXRpb25hbF9kb2N1bWVudGF0aW9uJTJGVXRpbGl0aWVzJTJGVW5peERhdGVUaW1l

# Methods

| Name | Description |
|  --- | --- |
| from_datetime | Converts a datetime object to a Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch). |
